sources.name: atlas
sources.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production transparent painted animation cutout atlas for a cozy travel jigsaw. Make a TRUE transparent RGBA image, transparent space between subjects (no opaque backdrop, no paper rectangle, no glow, no grid, no checkerboard). Exactly FIVE independent watercolor/gouache cutouts arranged 3 columns by 2 rows, sixth bottom-right cell entirely empty. Every subject fully contained inside its own cell with very wide transparent gutters, nothing crosses halfway horizontal divider or any column divider. Keep each subject below 360px tall in 512x512 cell, centered. Soft hand-painted pigment and fine brushwork, warm gentle daylight from upper left, natural modest saturation; no text or UI. Subjects are detailed parts from a whole cozy illustrated scene, not stickers, no outline, no artificial rim or drop shadow. A blue plaster garden and lavender path scene. TOP LEFT: one sage leafy stem, narrow, bottom cut stem anchor. TOP MIDDLE: one rosemary branch, bottom cut stem. TOP RIGHT: one slender purple lavender flower stem. BOTTOM LEFT: small golden-green rooted grass tuft, roots at bottom. BOTTOM MIDDLE: small delicate horizontal pale white cloud, translucent soft painted edges. Keep five separate subjects distinct.
